reasons: Depends on the moment service for correct data.

terms.meaning: The moment the site is built, before any visitor arrives.
Page details such as the tab title.

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports and listing rule
sections.what: Brings in the link, not-found helper, data functions, call card, view event and styles. Turns off pages for unlisted moments.
sections.why: Needed to build the page and to limit it to known moments.
sections.watch_out: Turning the listing rule back on would allow pages for moments that are not in the list.

sections.name: generateStaticParams
sections.title: Prebuilt moment list
sections.what: Lists every moment id so each moment page is built ahead of time.
sections.why: Likely reason: prebuilt pages load quickly and the set of moments is fixed.
sections.watch_out: Moments added later have no page until the site is rebuilt.

sections.name: generateMetadata
sections.title: Moment tab title
sections.what: Sets the tab title from the batting team and the runs and balls needed, or Decision Lab when the moment is missing.
sections.why: Likely reason: a descriptive title for each moment.
sections.watch_out: The fallback title only applies when the moment is missing, and the page then shows Not Found.

sections.name: MomentPage
sections.title: Moment page layout
sections.what: Looks up the moment, returns Not Found if missing, and draws the heading, season, venue and target, an over call link for one decision type, the call card, and a view event.
sections.why: Likely reason: the header explains the moment before the call card.
sections.watch_out: The over call link appears only for one decision type, so a new type will not show it.

summary: The page for one Decision Lab moment: shows its title, match details and the call card.
purpose: Shows one moment so a fan can make a call on it.
why: The setting dynamicParams false means only the listed moments have pages. Otherwise the reason is not stated.
how: Builds a page for each listed moment ahead of time, sets a title from the moment, looks the moment up, shows Not Found if missing, and otherwise draws the heading, match line, an over call link when relevant, the call card and a view event.
inputs: Moment id from the address and the list of moments from the domain service.
outputs: A moment page with the call card and a recorded view.
risks: Only listed moments exist, so a new moment needs a rebuild before it has a page. The Over Call link points to a page not visible here.
debug: If a moment returns Not Found, check listMoments and getMoment. If the title is wrong, check generateMetadata.
